item.title: EHF Euro 2026: Croatia Opens Tournament with Win Against Georgia (32-29) - Total Croatia
item.description: The Croatia men’s handball team opened their European Championship campaign with a hard-fought 32–29 win over Georgia in Group E action in Malmö, Sweden. It was a far tougher night than expected for the heavy favorites, as Georgia led several times and stayed in contention until the final minutes.
